copy.tagline: 掌握网页游戏开发与优化方法
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你想开发网页游戏但需要技术选型与优化指导
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to create web games but need guidance on tech choices and optimization

howto.what: 指导开发网页游戏：根据游戏类型选择框架，采用 WebGPU 并做 WebGL 回退，按优先级优化性能（压缩、懒加载、对象池等），并应用 PWA 和音频处理。
howto.when: 当用户请求开发网页游戏、询问框架选择或 WebGPU 用法时触发。

say.text: 帮我用 Phaser 做一个 2D 游戏，怎么优化加载？
say.note: 将给出资源压缩和懒加载等优化建议。

say.text: 网页游戏能用 WebGPU 吗？需要什么浏览器？
say.note: 会说明支持情况与兼容策略。

say.text: 给游戏加上 PWA 支持，实现离线游玩。

howto.what_en: Guides web game development: picks frameworks by game type, uses WebGPU with WebGL fallback, prioritizes performance optimizations (compression, lazy loading, object pooling), and applies PWA and audio handling.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the user asks to build a web game, asks about framework selection, or asks about WebGPU usage.

say_en.text: Help me make a 2D game with Phaser and optimize loading.
say_en.note: Will give asset compression and lazy loading tips.

say_en.text: Can my web game use WebGPU? Which browsers support it?
Add PWA support to the game for offline play.
say_en.note: Lists service worker and manifest requirements.
